description: This file defines a Sidebar React component for a note-taking application. It manages state for notes, handles fetching and deleting notes via an API client, and renders a UI with search, creation, and deletion functionalities, including note listing with date formatting and content truncation.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes from the API, optionally filtered by search term, and updates the state.

methods.name: handleDeleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note after user confirmation, updates the notes list, and calls callback.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a date string into a short locale date, including the year if not current year.

methods.name: truncateContent
methods.description: Truncates note content to a specified maximum length, adding ellipsis if exceeded.
